verses.1: On the seventh day of the month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Eliashama, from the tribe of the kings, and the chief of the kings, along with twelve men, went to Gideon son of Ahikam, the high priest. There they ate bread together in the tent.
verses.2: And Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, and the twelve men who were with him, attacked Gideon, son of Ahijah, son of Shaphan, in the battle. Gideon died, as he had appointed the king of Babylon to rule over the land.
verses.3: And all the Jews who were with David at Mizpah, and also those captives who were found there among the soldiers, Joshua killed them.
verses.4: And on the second day of killing Gideon, no one knew about it.
verses.5: And men came from Shechem, from Silo and from Samaria. Each of them brought with them an old man who was covered in wounds and torn clothes. They also brought gifts and offerings, with which they hoped to build the house of Jehovah.
verses.6: And Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, went out to answer their call from the hill. He walked slowly towards them. When he arrived, he said to them, “Go to Gadiel, son of Ahikam.”
verses.7: And when they entered into the city, Jezabel, daughter of Netanya, slaughtered them. And those people who were with her also died.
verses.8: And twelve men were found among them. They said to Joshua, “Do not kill us, for we have grain and lentils, honey, and fruit in our fields.” But he did not kill them within their own land.
verses.9: And the trumpet that Ismael threw there, could be heard by all the people who were killed by God. This was the same trumpet that King Asa used against the Israelites. It was filled with the voices of Ismael, son of Nethaniah.
verses.10: And Ishmael took into his service all the remaining people who were still in the camp. He also took into his service all those who had been left behind in the camp. Nebuzaradan, a high-ranking officer, was assigned to lead Gideon, son of Ahijah. Ishmael then gathered them together and went to lead them towards the children of Ammon.
verses.11: And Jonathan, son of Gideon, and all the soldiers who were with him heard all the evil that Ismael, son of Nethaniah, had done.
verses.12: They took all the men and went to fight against Sisera, son of Nunya. They found him by the waters of the Jordan River.
verses.13: And all the people saw that Joshua, son of Nun, and all the commanders of the army rejoiced.
verses.14: And all the people who had returned from the desert gathered together. They went back to Joshua, son of Nun.
verses.15: And Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, went away in hiding from Jonathan. He then went to the children of Ammon.
verses.16: And Jonathan, son of Gideon, and all the soldiers who were with him, took back all the rest of the people who had been taken captive from Israel by Shemaiah, son of Netanyah. They also took back Gedaliah, son of Ahikam, along with the men of war, women, and children who had been taken captive from Gibeon.
verses.17: And they went and settled in the land where they had lived before, that is, near the house of Laban, so that they could go to Egypt.
verses.18: Because of the treacherous people, they feared that Ishmael son of Nethaniah would kill Gedalya son of Ahikam, who had been appointed king over Babylon in that land.
